name: Links
description: Coastal links. Firm, fast and windswept, with hardly a tree in sight.

name: Heathland
description: Sandy heathland, pine and heather. Drains beautifully.

name: Parkland
description: Mature parkland with big old trees and soft turf.

description: Upland moor. Rugged, wild and usually a bit damp.
